headline: ASP-led recovery; H2 execution holds the key

highlights: EBITDA declined 0.7% YoY to Rs1,439mn, missing NBIE/consensus estimates by 2.8%/6.2%.
Adjusted PAT declined 8.6% YoY to Rs181mn, adjusted for the Rs83mn VRS expense in the base quarter.

Franchise and I&D channels grew double-digit, with KRO reach expanding 2.6x YoY to 3,895 outlets (target: 5,000+ by 3QFY27) and MBO presence exceeding 17,000 outlets, supported by mid-20s secondary sales growth.
Bata.com grew 26%, although overall e-commerce growth was limited to 5.4% by deferred B2B orders.
valuation: Franchise and I&D channels grew double-digit, with KRO reach expanding 2.6x YoY to 3,895 outlets (target: 5,000+ by 3QFY27) and MBO presence exceeding 17,000 outlets, supported by mid-20s secondary sales growth.
Valuation: We upgrade Bata to Buy from Hold, retaining our TP of Rs772 valuing at 34x Sept’28 EPS, as the implied upside now is at 22%.
At Cmp of Rs663 the stock trades at 39x FY27E and ~30x FY28E P/E.
watch: Franchise-led expansion should support profitability, with execution under the new CEO remaining key.
With volumes yet to recover and margins under pressure, FY27E earnings face a downside risk unless new launches and pricing benefits drive a sharp H2 recovery.
